login.title: Fixfly Pro
login.subtitle: Sign in to manage your tasks
login.networkError: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection, or whether the server is running.
login.tooManyAttempts: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a minute and try again.

tasks.title: My tasks
tasks.syncFailed: ⚠ Could not send — open the task

taskDetail.rejectPlaceholder: Why can't you take this task?
taskDetail.rejectHint: The task goes back to the dispatcher with your explanation.
taskDetail.rejectReasonRequiredBody: You must enter a reason before rejecting the task.
taskDetail.actionError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
taskDetail.noTechniciansForLocation: No technicians with app access are assigned to this location.
taskDetail.resolveQueuedBody: No connection. Your resolution and photos are stored and will be sent as soon as you are back online — nothing needs redoing.
taskDetail.queuePendingBody: Saved on this device. It will be sent automatically once you are back online.
taskDetail.queueFailedBody: The server refused it — the task may have been reassigned or closed meanwhile. Retry, or discard what was saved.
taskDetail.queueDiscardBody: The comment and photos will be permanently deleted from this device.
taskDetail.handoverPlaceholder: What does the new technician need to know? (e.g. water is off, key with the neighbour)

lock.unlockBody: Enter your PIN or sign in with face/fingerprint.
lock.setPinBody: For quick sign-in instead of typing your password every time.
lock.useFullLogin: Sign in with email and password

chat.title: Conversations
chat.subtitle: Messages per task
chat.empty: No messages yet. Write the first one.
chat.noThreads: No conversations yet. Open a task and send the first message.
chat.internalHint: Only you and management see this. The technician has no access.
chat.readOnly: This job is no longer assigned to you. You can read the conversation but not write.
chat.removeFromListBody: This only removes the thread from your list. The messages are kept and management still sees them.

profile.logoutConfirmBody: Are you sure you want to log out?
profile.appLockHint: Ask for a PIN or biometrics on open
profile.appLockOffBody: Your PIN will be deleted. The app stays signed in until you log out manually — anyone who opens the phone will see your tasks.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot password
forgotPassword.emailPrompt: Enter the email address you sign in with. We will send you a code to set a new password.
forgotPassword.codePrompt: If {{email}} is registered, a code has been sent to it. It is valid for 15 minutes.
forgotPassword.passwordRule: At least 8 characters, including a letter and a digit.
forgotPassword.requestError: Could not send the code. Check your connection.

forgotPin.title: Forgot PIN
forgotPin.sending: Sending a code to your email address...
forgotPin.sentTo: We sent a code to {{email}}. It is valid for 15 minutes.
forgotPin.sent: A code has been sent to your email address. It is valid for 15 minutes.
forgotPin.sendError: Could not send the code. Check your connection.
forgotPin.codeError: That code is not valid or has expired.

inbox.title: Tickets
inbox.allClearBody: Nothing is waiting on your decision.
inbox.backlogBody: {{count}} tickets older than {{days}} days — kept out of the inbox
inbox.backlogHint: Sitting longer than {{days}} days — too long to be today’s work. Select and close them together.
inbox.bulkCloseBody: {{count}} tickets will be closed. This cannot be undone from the app.
inbox.noAssignees: Nobody with app access is assigned to this location.

hint.unowned: Rejected or timed out — nobody is holding this and it will not move on its own.
hint.urgentUnaccepted: Flagged urgent and still not picked up.
hint.staleInPool: In the pool longer than the acceptance window allows.
hint.acceptanceExpiring: If the technician does not accept in time, it bounces back automatically.
hint.awaitingClosure: Resolved with proof attached. Review and close.

inbox.closeConfirm: This ticket will be closed. It cannot be undone from the app.

assigned.empty: No assigned tickets match this selection.

managerProfile.nameHint: The name you sign chat messages with. Without it technicians see your email address.
managerProfile.horizonHint: How many days back tickets stay under "To handle". Older ones move to "To clear".

sys.4: {{who}} did not accept in time — the report went back to dispatch
sys.6: {{by}} marked the report URGENT — the acceptance window is now {{minutes}} min
sys.7: {{by}} removed the URGENT flag — the acceptance window is {{minutes}} min again
